defect: pathInScope() treats a scope entry of './' (repository root, which pick_made issues when a finding's path has no directory) as matching nothing: no path starts with './', so a root-scoped builder mandate rejects every change.

repro.cmd: node -e "import('./src/index.js').then(P=>{ if (!P.pathInScope('README.md',['./']) || !P.pathInScope('src/a.js',['./'])) { console.error('root scope matches nothing'); process.exit(1) } })"

evidence.notes: Expected: './' (and '.' and '') mean the whole repository. Same normalization is needed in ingest's inScope() and in the GitHub adapter's enforceMandate, which share the rule.
